data.one_liner: Client to access GSettings database for storing user preferences on Linux.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart client to access GSettings, the settings database used for storing user preferences on Linux. Allows reading, writing, and listening to changes on GSettings keys via D-Bus.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter or Dart desktop application targeting Linux.
You need to integrate with native GNOME or desktop user preferences using GSettings.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform storage (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS).
You are looking for a general-purpose key-value store independent of Linux desktop environments.
strengths: Native integration with Linux GSettings and D-Bus.
Supports memory and keyfile backends and schema directories.
weaknesses: Limited exclusively to the Linux platform.
Requires proper D-Bus and GSettings schema setup on the host system.
data.setup_notes: Requires Linux environment with D-Bus and GSettings support.
